items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: And I went to the entertainers and worked with Carl Dixon from one to five.

ctx.x: And before that I got a job after the Dream and the Clos, working from eight to, I'm sorry, eight to twelve at Municipal Pier in Chicago. I went to Tate's Big Band. Oh, Thurston Tate. Yeah. And I worked until twelve o'clock in Dutray, taking sick. I'm a little ahead of my story then. And I went to the entertainers and worked with Carl Dixon from one to five. And after Dutray got well, then I went with Oliver. That's where it was.
Where was the entertainers? On 35th? Yeah, 35th.
